metaDesc: Publish comics and web novels in Khmer and English, build a following and earn from Fast Pass.
title: Share your comics and stories with readers across Cambodia
lead: Publish in Khmer, English or both. Keep your rights, build a following, and earn when readers unlock your newest episodes early.
step1Desc: Title, genre, summary and a 3:4 cover. Takes about 15 minutes.
step2Desc: Within 1–2 days. If something needs fixing, we tell you exactly what.
step3Desc: Upload episodes and schedule them. Subscribers get an alert.
step4Desc: Reply to comments, watch your stats, and turn on Fast Pass.
earnBody1: Turn on Fast Pass and readers can pay {price} coins to read your newest episodes before they’re free. Every Fast Pass episode becomes free for everyone after 7 days, so nobody is locked out.
earnBody2: You get [REVENUE SHARE]% of the coin value. Payouts go to your ABA or other Cambodian bank account.
calcReaders: Readers who unlock each Fast Pass episode
calcOutLabel: Coins readers spend on your series each month
calcNote: An example, not a promise. Real earnings depend on your readers.
tool1Desc: Views, subscribers and coins earned, updated hourly.
tool2Desc: Upload ahead and release at the best time for your readers.
tool3Desc: Publish in one language or both as separate versions.
tool4Desc: Talk to readers and pin your notes to the top.
tool5Desc: Readers unlock your newest episodes early with coins.
tool6Desc: Clear review feedback and creator support by email or Telegram.
rulesDesc: We check every new series against these. Most get approved the first time.
rule1: Your original work, or work you have the rights to
rule2: An honest age rating (All ages, 13+, 16+ or 18+)
rule3: A clean 3:4 cover with no watermark
rule4: No phone numbers, links or ads in the title or summary
rule5: Comic images 690–1600 px wide; chapters of at least 300 words
rule6: A regular schedule, or a note to readers when you take a break
q1: Do I need to be a professional?
a1: No. Many creators start with a phone and a free drawing app. What matters is a story readers want to come back to.
a2: Yes. Publish in Khmer, English, or both as separate versions. Readers choose which language they see.
a3: You do. You give PhumiReader permission to show your series on the app, as set out in the creator agreement. You can hide your series at any time.
a4: Usually 1–2 days for a new series. If we need changes, we list exactly what to fix and you can resubmit right away.
a5: Earnings come from Fast Pass coins. Payouts go to your bank account on [PAYOUT SCHEDULE] once you pass [MIN PAYOUT].
ctaTitle: Your first episode could be live this week
ctaDesc: Create your series now. You can save a draft and finish later.
